reason: split_cents_exact does not return shares summing to total_cents for negative totals. With total_cents=-100 and weights [1,1,1], floors are [-33,-33,-33] (sum -99), rem=-1, and order[:rem] is order[:-1], which increments two shares, giving [-32,-32,-33] (sum -97). The zero-total-weight branch also returns all zeros, which does not sum to total_cents. Negative totals are in scope because sum_cents already handles negatives, and the added tests only cover a positive case, so the suite passes without catching this.
